prompt:
A 2x2 photo grid montage. All 4 panels are shot in the EXACT SAME SPACE: an open cream canvas tote bag laid out on a lawn outdoors, with the same palette and the same light in every panel, but each panel is a completely different shot. Every panel is a medium to wide shot framed from a distance: the WHOLE tote bag is always fully inside the frame with the lawn visible around all four sides of it, the camera stays back and never moves in close, and the product stays small in the frame. The product in the reference image is kept exactly as it is - same shape, cap, label and content, with no alteration, and it is the unmistakable hero of every panel. There is only one product in the whole image.

Top left panel: 45-degree overhead shot from a raised height, the whole open canvas tote fully in frame with the green lawn extending to all four edges, no hands in frame, a pink acrylic case, a pair of pink sunglasses, a pink hair tie, a half-finished iced latte cropped by the left edge of the frame, and the product standing in the centre of the canvas with everything around it in focus and nothing blocking it.

Top right panel: straight-down top view of the whole bag, the bag fully in frame with the lawn visible around it, the product standing in the centre, a pair of pink sunglasses resting diagonally on the strap, a half-open pink case and a pink lipstick beside it, no hands in frame.

Bottom left panel: 45-degree overhead angle from further back, taking in the whole canvas surface plus a wide margin of green lawn around it, the product standing in the centre with the pink sunglasses, the pink hair tie and the half-finished iced latte around it, all in focus, no hands in frame.

Bottom right panel: high-angle overhead shot framed from a distance, the whole bag in frame with the lawn around it, her hand reaching in from the top of the frame to set down a pair of pink sunglasses on the canvas without touching the product, the product standing in the centre with the pink case, the pink hair tie and the iced latte around it, all in focus and nothing blocking the product.

All panels share the same look: candid lifestyle photography, the look of a moment just after she sat down and before anything was tidied, off-centre asymmetric composition with objects scattered at different angles and cropped by the frame, hard midday sun with crisp-edged shadows, a bright palette of cream canvas, candy pink, fresh green grass and latte beige, the product is the only glass-and-metal highlight in the frame - one crisp highlight on the clear glass body and the gold cap - while every prop stays matte, next to daily essentials like a pink acrylic case, pink sunglasses, a pink hair tie and a half-finished iced latte, only a partial presence of a woman - hands, arms and shoulder - never her face and never a full body, and no men anywhere in the image, the product resting on a raised surface and never on the floor, the product at its true real-world scale, small and pocket-sized next to hands and props, realistic hand anatomy, clean image, no text, no watermark, no UI elements, no play buttons, no timestamps, photorealistic.
